description: Create a one-time full-report payment order for an existing scan_id. Does not transfer funds. Only set consent_immediate_delivery=true after the payer has expressly agreed to immediate digital delivery and applicable withdrawal terms. Returns order_id, exact Polygon USDT amount, and recipient address; then submit the confirmed transaction hash via verify_full_report_payment.

consent_immediate_delivery.description: Must be true only after the payer explicitly agrees to immediate digital delivery and the applicable withdrawal-right terms.

scan_id.description: Scan identifier returned by scan_tls for the domain whose full report is being ordered.

name: create_full_report_order
title: Create a USDT Polygon payment order
